name: Funnel Chart
description: A horizontal funnel drawn as one smooth tapering band split into coloured stages, with each stage's share of the first and a tile per stage.

props.name: stages
props.type: { name: string; value: number; color?: string }[]
props.description: The stages from first to last. The band is as tall as each value at the middle of its stage. Colours follow the chart palette unless given.

props.name: format
props.description: Writes counts in the tiles and tooltip. Defaults to grouped whole numbers.

props.name: height
props.description: Plot height in pixels. The width follows the card.

props.name: tiles
props.description: Show a tile per stage with its colour, count and name under the plot.

props.name: track
props.description: Draw a pale track behind the band, showing what each stage lost against the largest.

props.name: summary
props.description: What the chart shows, for screen readers. Generated from the data when left out.

props.name: label
props.description: Small muted label at the top of the card.

props.name: delta
props.description: Change as a signed fraction, shown as a chip beside the value: 0.052 is +5.2%.

props.name: action
props.description: A control on the right of the header.

props.name: footer
props.description: Replaces the stage tiles under the plot.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the card, e.g. a width. Also accepts caption, note, invertDelta and every other prop of a div.
